##### Project general facts

La Residenza by Dalands is an exemplary residential development, offering a collection of signature one and two-bedroom homes. With a focus on creating a superior customer experience, the project features spacious, high-ceiling homes with expansive balconies and premium flooring. Impeccable planning and attention to fine details, from the impressive lobby to the smallest detail in each flat, showcase the developer's expertise gained from the luxury hospitality business, creating a residence that truly enhances your style.

Residents enjoy a range of premium features designed to elevate everyday living, including a pool on the first floor with a silk flow waterfall and wet bar, mood and ambient lighting across rooms, and separate shower and bathtub spaces. Natural marble flooring in common areas, motion-sensor illuminated wardrobes, bespoke cabinetry and ironmongery, high-speed elevators, and premium branded fixtures, fittings, and appliances complete the offering. Every element is crafted to set you apart and redefine premium living.

Every residence at La Residenza features quality fittings that underline your class, with spacious layouts designed for comfortable living. The interiors reflect a commitment to excellence with premium branded fixtures and appliances throughout. From the thoughtfully designed living spaces to the elegant bathrooms, every detail is crafted to provide a living experience that is both sophisticated and welcoming.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Jumeirah Village Circle, one of Dubai's newest and most exciting residential developments, this exceptional location offers convenient access to some of Dubai's iconic landmarks. Easy entry and exit to Al Khail Road ensures seamless connectivity, with Gadaf Community Park, JSS School, Circle Mall, Dubai Hills Mall, Medcare Barsha, Mall of the Emirates, Burj Khalifa, City Walk, Jumeirah Beach, and Dubai International Airport all within easy reach.

The location is distinguished by its family-friendly environment and abundant green spaces. JVC offers a tranquil retreat from the bustling city while maintaining excellent connectivity to Dubai's key destinations. The community's well-planned infrastructure and proximity to essential amenities make it an ideal choice for families and professionals alike.

For those seeking a residence that embodies exemplary living, community connection, and a prime Dubai address, Jumeirah Village Circle delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of green spaces, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can live the exemplary life.
